standard_prerequisites.use: The Varieties lemma that geometric irreducibility of a scheme over a field is preserved and reflected by arbitrary field extension; cited input with the fibre identification written in the retained span.

core_obligations: Identify the fibre X'_{y'} with the base change of X_y to Spec(kappa(y')).
Apply the after-field-extension criterion for geometric irreducibility.
Conclude the two subsets of Y' agree.

proof_roadmap.step: Rewrite fibres of the base change as field extensions of original fibres.

difficulty_reason: For any morphism f : X -> Y and any base change g : Y' -> Y with projection f' : X' -> Y', the subset of Y' where the fibres of f' are geometrically irreducible equals the inverse image under g of the corresponding subset of Y, i.e. geometric irreducibility of fibres depends only on the base point up to field extension. The retained proof is written out: it reduces to the assertion that for y' over y the fibre X'_{y'} = X_y x_y y' is geometrically irreducible over kappa(y') iff X_y is geometrically irreducible over kappa(y), and concludes by the Varieties lemma that geometric irreducibility is checked after arbitrary field extension. Retained author proof at lines 7443-7450.
